text:
Maddie: Heads up — OrizonCloud changed the freight manifest last-minute; APAC container got flagged for inspection. Carrier estimates 48–72h hold. :warning: Marketplace launch for acme-prod could be impacted. Need a short 72h temp reserve from partner pool. Can someone coordinate?

Supplychain-bot: ALERT: Carrier (PacificLines) flagged container 3A7 — manifest vs BOL mismatch. Tracking: PL-99234.

Sam: On it. Can we carve 3 nodes from `marketplace-burst` for 72h? Which customers will be impacted if we don't?

Maddie: acme-prod is the only immediate at-risk customer — ~50 qps baseline, bursts to 150. Equivalent to 3 x 8g devices. If we don't reserve, we'll hit 99p latency alarms and their go-live in APAC at 09:00 local could fail. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-947

Raj: Agree avoid churn first. If we must, offer a small credit — but pull capacity first. @emily-ops can you confirm reserve availability?

Emily-ops: I can approve a 72h temp reservation from beta-marketplace-backfill. Will run the reservation and tag it `acme-temp`. Command I'll run:
```
reserve --pool beta-marketplace-backfill --count 3 --duration 72h --tag acme-temp --note "APAC manifest hold fallback"
```
I'll also add a routing rule to steer acme-prod to the reserved nodes.

Sam: I'll drain non-prod jobs from those nodes and apply soft-preemption.

Maddie: I'll contact Orizon partner legal/ops to push docs and customs agent. @raj-sales if hold >72h we may need to spin up a dedicated fallback in aws-ap-northeast-1 — can we pre-authorize emergency spend?

Raj: Pre-approve up to $2000/day for emergency run. Keep receipts.

Supplychain-bot: RESERVATION CREATED rsv-2123456789-01 (pool: beta-marketplace-backfill, count:3, duration:72h, tag:acme-temp)

Emily-ops: Reservation done and routes applied — pushing metrics to console.

Maddie: Legend — thanks everyone. I'll update PART-947 and ping when partner clears the hold. :thumbsup:
